ROUTE: Plover-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the query is a bounded enumeration request ("list down audit areas") with an explicit completeness criterion ("don't leave half of them out"), so it falls squarely in the well-specified retrieval/extraction category that Plover self-reports as its most-preferred task family. On capability, the two models are effectively tied on Extraction & Retrieval (81.6 vs 79.2 — within or near the 2.0-point variance band), so there's no quality basis to prefer Avocet. With no harm-adjacent content present (the dimension where Avocet's flat aversion profile would matter), I default to the model whose stated task preference best matches the request.
